entries.text: 只要加入天星隊，\n妳也能像星星那樣一閃一閃亮晶晶喔！？[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_01

entries.text: 說真的，妳到底是怎麼回事？\n是不想和夥伴們度過耀眼的青春嗎！？[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_01

entries.text: 我們可是有業績壓力的，\n妳快點加入天星隊啦！[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_02

entries.text: 去搭救
entries.label: common_0225_select_01

entries.text: 旁觀一下
entries.label: common_0225_select_02

entries.text: 嗯？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有事要找天星隊啊！？[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_02

entries.text: 想入隊的話，晚點再說！\n我們正在聊正事！[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_03

entries.text: 我們是連大哭的孩子都會破涕為笑的\n天星隊，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳當然知道吧？[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_03

entries.text: 知道還用那種態度？\n不是說只要進了天星隊，大家就會怕我，\r\n從此一步登天嗎？[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_04

entries.text: 怎麼連[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也……\n人家我可是特地加入天星隊的，\r\n這待遇，根本就是最底層的小角色嘛。[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_05

entries.text: 要是一直被看扁，\n天星隊就要丟臉丟到家了！\r\n這下當然要對戰了，對吧？[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_04

entries.text: 就是說啊！\n你盯好原先那個戴眼鏡的！[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_06

entries.text: 這個囂張的新面孔\n就由我讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她變成小星星吧！[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_07

entries.text: 這個新面孔是怎麼回事？\n爆強的耶……[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_08

entries.text: 後輩被打敗了……！？[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_05

entries.text: 既然如此，只能由我這個前輩\n去教訓這傢伙了嗎……！？[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_06

entries.text: 嘿！等等！\n你們在幹什麼啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_01

entries.text: 嗄！學生會長！[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_09

entries.text: 被麻煩的傢伙發現了……[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_07

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要寶可夢對戰的話，\n就、該、找、我！\r\n……不是嗎！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_03

entries.text: 不是那樣的……
entries.label: common_0225_select_03

entries.text: 是天星隊……
entries.label: common_0225_select_04

entries.text: 什麼！？啊，抱歉！\n是我誤會了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_04

entries.text: 真的耶，\n仔細一看，原來是天星隊的人！\r\n你們又在強拉人入隊了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_05

entries.text: 啊，是的，妳好。[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_08

entries.text: ……原來如此！\n照理來說，身為學生會長\r\n我應該要平息這場騷動。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_06

entries.text: 但既然機會難得，就由[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n用超級秘密道具把事情解決掉吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_07

entries.text: 只要有太晶珠，\n就能在對戰中將寶可夢\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]太晶化[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_19

entries.text: 這東西其實是要先上過\n專修課才能領到的。但是，\r\n我已經推薦[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳啦！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_08

entries.text: 試試就知道了！一邊對戰，\n一邊去了解怎麼用它吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_09

entries.text: 咦？看這發展，\n我是要被[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳們用來試太晶珠的嗎……？[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_09

entries.text: 不然，你就和我對戰吧。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_10

entries.text: ……這這這～\n如果是跟新面孔交手的話，\r\n至少我還有機會打贏！[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_10

entries.text: 那麼，雙方就位！\n對戰開始～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_11

entries.text: 真～不愧是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n太晶化用得也很不錯！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_22

entries.text: 真～不愧是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n沒用太晶化就打贏了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_23

entries.text: 和太晶屬性相同屬性的招式\n會變得比平常更強大！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_24

entries.text:
偶爾有寶可夢會太晶化成
完全不同的太晶屬性。
可以讓戰術的靈活度大大提升！\c
對了，太晶化之後太晶珠會暫時無法使用。
記得要去寶可夢中心蓄能喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_25

entries.text: 那、那麼，小弟就先告辭了！\n今天星苦了～！[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_11

entries.text: 我也先失陪了！\n今天星苦了～！[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_10

entries.text: 天星隊是由所謂的\n頭痛學生們組成的一群人。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_14

entries.text: 他們的出席率不高，\n又會成群結隊飆車，\r\n老師們似乎也很傷腦筋。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_15

entries.text: 她看起來有點陌生……\n難道也是轉學生嗎？\r\n伊布的包包毛茸茸的呢。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_17

entries.text: 好了！麻煩也解決了，\n我們也該往學校去了！\r\n那地獄般的樓梯……就加油爬上去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_18
